title: Monkeys decide to fast unto death
introduction: Monkeys decide to fast unto death as they failed in executing Sugreeva command. Sugreeva already said that anyone returning after timeframe might deem himself as dead. Thus, Angada casting aspersions on Sugreeva and his ruthless commands, takes this decision on many counts. All the other monkeys follow the suite.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे पंच पंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 55th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यम् प्रश्रितम् धर्म संहितम् |
स्वामि सत्कार संयुक्तम् अंगदो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
śrutvā hanumato vākyam praśritam dharma saṃhitam |
svāmi satkāra saṃyuktam aṃgado vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing the polite and righteous words of Hanuma, which are just yeomanly towards Hanuma's lord, namely Sugreeva, Angada said these sentences.

verses.devanagari:
स्थैर्यमात्ममनःशौचमानृशंस्यमथाअर्जवम् - यद्व -
स्थैर्यम् आत्म मनः शौचम् आनृशंस्यम् अथ आर्जवम् |
विक्रमः चैव धैर्यम् च सुग्रीवे न उपपद्यते
verses.iast:
sthairyamātmamanaḥśaucamānṛśaṃsyamathāarjavam - yadva -
sthairyam ātma manaḥ śaucam ānṛśaṃsyam atha ārjavam |
vikramaḥ caiva dhairyam ca sugrīve na upapadyate
verses.translation: "Un-deducible in Sugreeva are his steadiness, or harmlessness, or frankness, also thus salience, or even valiance, further more cleanliness of heart or soul.

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातुः ज्येष्ठस्य यो भार्याम् जीवितो महिषीम् प्रियाम् |
धर्मेण मातरम् यः तु स्वीकरोति जुगुप्सितः
कथम् स धर्मम् जानीते येन भ्रात्रा दुरात्मना |
युद्धाय अभिनियुक्तेन बिलस्य पिहितम् मुखम्
verses.iast:
bhrātuḥ jyeṣṭhasya yo bhāryām jīvito mahiṣīm priyām |
dharmeṇa mātaram yaḥ tu svīkaroti jugupsitaḥ
katham sa dharmam jānīte yena bhrātrā durātmanā |
yuddhāya abhiniyuktena bilasya pihitam mukham
verses.translation: "Which Sugreeva has arrogated his elder brother's wife when that elder brother is still alive and well, where she is morally his motherlike, an empress and a lady love of that elder brother, thus he is despicable, and which Sugreeva closed the mouth of the cavity when his brother in all his belief assigned and stationed him alone at the mouth of the cavity to fightback the demon Dundubhi if he tries to escape, all the more when his own brother is still inside the cavity, thus he is nefarious, how then he can be said as one conversant with moral rectitude?

glosses.meaning: elder, brother, while alive and well
who by brother [Vali,] to fightback [the demon,] assigned

verses.devanagari:
सत्यात् पाणि गृहीतः च कृत कर्मा महायशाः |
विस्मृतो राघवो येन स कस्य सुकृतम् स्मरेत्
verses.iast:
satyāt pāṇi gṛhītaḥ ca kṛta karmā mahāyaśāḥ |
vismṛto rāghavo yena sa kasya sukṛtam smaret
verses.translation: "Which Sugreeva has overlooked no less than the great glorious Raghava, whom he truthfully befriended and from whom his own task of arrogating my kingdom by eliminating my father is facilitated, how then can he remember the good services of others like us?
notes: For this statement Hanuma may retort saying 'Sugreeva has not overlooked Rama but otherwise engrossed in material comforts. He sent all of us all over to search for Seetha in requital to the help rendered by Rama... is it not the upright conduct of Sugreeva?' For that Angada is ready with an answer as.

glosses.meaning: truthfully, hand, on taking [handshake, befriending,] also
he [Sugreeva,] whose [others like us,] good, services, he remembers.

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणस्य भयेन इह न अधर्म भय भीरुणा |
आदिष्टा मार्गितुम् सीताम् धर्मः तस्मिन् कथम् भवेत्
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇasya bhayena iha na adharma bhaya bhīruṇā |
ādiṣṭā mārgitum sītām dharmaḥ tasmin katham bhavet
verses.translation: "He has ordered and sent us for searching Seetha owing to the fear from Lakshmana, but not as a coward fearing his own unscrupulousness, how then can scrupulosity be manifest in him?

glosses.meaning: for Seetha, to search, we are ordered [and sent]
un, scrupulousness, fearing, as a coward

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् पापे कृतघ्ने तु स्मृति भिन्ने चल आत्मनि |
आर्यः को विश्वसेत् जातु तत् कुलीनो विशेषतः
verses.iast:
tasmin pāpe kṛtaghne tu smṛti bhinne cala ātmani |
āryaḥ ko viśvaset jātu tat kulīno viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "Who is that respectable one who can put belief in Sugreeva, while that Sugreeva is shameful by his shameless act of eliminating my father, and unmindful of tradition in usurping my mother and throne, and unthankful in requiting Rama by himself, instead of using us as pawns, and changeful in ignoring his promise to Rama, but in fearing for Lakshmana? Will it be possible especially for one like me belonging to his family?

glosses.meaning: remembrance, goes against - contrary to tradition, unmindful one
to his, one belonging - one belonging to his family.

verses.devanagari:
राज्ये पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठाप्यः स गुणो निर्गुणो अपि वा |
कथम् शत्रु कुलीनम् माम् सुग्रीवो जीवयिष्यति
verses.iast:
rājye putraḥ pratiṣṭhāpyaḥ sa guṇo nirguṇo api vā |
katham śatru kulīnam mām sugrīvo jīvayiṣyati
verses.translation: "Whether a son is honest or dishonest he alone is investable in the kingdom. How then can Sugreeva let me, the one from the family of his enemy, live on?
notes: This is in reply to Hanuma's advise, 'he establishes you only in kingdom, as before...' as at 4-54-20. But Hanuma cannot rebut Angada for he has no valid proof to show to Angada about Sugreeva's goodness towards Angada, as sermonised by Hanuma in the earlier chapter. Hence, 'better to follow the leader, than to argue...' is the only option left to Hanuma.

glosses.itrans: sa guNaH vaa nir guNaH api
glosses.iast: sa guṇaḥ vā nir guṇaḥ api
glosses.devanagari: स गुणः वा निर् गुणः अपि
glosses.meaning: with, honesty, or, without, honesty, whether

verses.devanagari:
भिन्न मन्त्रो अपराद्धः च हीन शक्तिः कथम् हि अहम् |
किष्किन्धाम् प्राप्य जीवेयम् अनाथ इव दुर्बलः
verses.iast:
bhinna mantro aparāddhaḥ ca hīna śaktiḥ katham hi aham |
kiṣkindhām prāpya jīveyam anātha iva durbalaḥ
verses.translation: "My slyness in planning to live in Black Hole has backfired, I am now culpable in not finding Seetha being the troop leader, and I am a powerless as you all are Sugreeva's side, how then can I live on indeed after reaching Kishkindha, like caitiff turned into a wretch.

verses.devanagari:
उपांशु दण्डेन हि माम् बंधनेन उपपादयेत् |
शठः क्रूरो नृशंसः च सुग्रीवो राज्य कारणात्
verses.iast:
upāṃśu daṇḍena hi mām baṃdhanena upapādayet |
śaṭhaḥ krūro nṛśaṃsaḥ ca sugrīvo rājya kāraṇāt
verses.translation: "Indeed he surceases me by some mysterious trammelling punishment, for that Sugreeva becomes disingenuous, ferocious, also barbarous just for the reason of his kingship.

verses.devanagari:
बंधनात् च अवसादात् मे श्रेयः प्रायोपवेशनम् |
अनुजानंतु माम् सर्वे गृहम् गच्छंतु वानराः
verses.iast:
baṃdhanāt ca avasādāt me śreyaḥ prāyopaveśanam |
anujānaṃtu mām sarve gṛham gacchaṃtu vānarāḥ
verses.translation: "Fast unto death behoves me than trammels and tramples, thus you all be acquiescent to my proposal and you may go back to your dwellings.

glosses.meaning: than trammels, also, than tramples, to me
to dwelling place, may go back.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् वः प्रतिजानामि न गमिष्यामि अहम् पुरीम् |
इह एव प्रायम् आसिष्ये श्रेयो मरणम् एव मे
verses.iast:
aham vaḥ pratijānāmi na gamiṣyāmi aham purīm |
iha eva prāyam āsiṣye śreyo maraṇam eva me
verses.translation: "I am reiterating to you all that I do not wish to go to the city of Kishkindha, and here only I sit fasting unto death, as death alone is expedient to me.

glosses.meaning: I am, to you all, reiterating
I am, to city, not, I wish to go
here, only, fast unto death, I will sit out
to me, death, alone, is expedient.

verses.devanagari:
अभिवादन पूर्वम् तु राजा कुशलम् एव च |
अभिवादन पूर्वम् तु राघवौ बलशालिनौ
वाच्यः तातः यवीयान् मे सुग्रीवो वानर ईश्वरः |
verses.iast:
abhivādana pūrvam tu rājā kuśalam eva ca |
abhivādana pūrvam tu rāghavau balaśālinau
vācyaḥ tātaḥ yavīyān me sugrīvo vānara īśvaraḥ |
verses.translation: "On my behalf Raghava-s wellbeing may be enquired firstly paying deference to them, so also the wellbeing of my paternal uncle and king may be enquired, only after paying deference to that lord of vanara-s.

verses.devanagari:
आरोग्य पूर्वम् कुशलम् वाच्या माता रुमा च मे
मातरम् चैव मे ताराम् आश्वासयितुम् अर्हथ |
प्रकृत्या प्रिय पुत्रा सा सानुक्रोशा तपस्विनी
विनष्टम् माम् इह श्रुत्वा व्यक्तम् हास्यति जीवितम् |
verses.iast:
ārogya pūrvam kuśalam vācyā mātā rumā ca me
mātaram caiva me tārām āśvāsayitum arhatha |
prakṛtyā priya putrā sā sānukrośā tapasvinī
vinaṣṭam mām iha śrutvā vyaktam hāsyati jīvitam |
verses.translation: "My step-mother Ruma may be asked after regarding her healthiness. And it will be apt of you to solace my mother Lady Tara, who by her nature is a warm-hearted and austerely lady who cherishes her son more, and such as she is she will obviously leave off her life on hearing that I breathed my last." So said Angada to all monkeys.

glosses.meaning: my, of mother, Lady Tara, also thus
having cherished, son [who cherishes her more]
she - such as she is - my mother Lady Tara
me, as perished one, on hearing

verses.devanagari:
एतावत् उक्त्वा वचनम् वृद्धान् तान् अभिवाद्य च
विवेश अंगदो भूमौ रुदन् दर्भेषु दुर्मनाः |
verses.iast:
etāvat uktvā vacanam vṛddhān tān abhivādya ca
viveśa aṃgado bhūmau rudan darbheṣu durmanāḥ |
verses.translation: On speaking to that point and after paying deference to older vanara-s available there, Angada puling glum facedly reclined on the sacred grass spread on ground.

glosses.meaning: to that point, words, on speaking
them, older [vanara-s, available there,]on paying deference, also
on ground, on sacred grass, entered - reclined.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य संविशतः तत्र रुदन्तो वानर ऋषभाः
नयनेभ्यः प्रमुमुचुः उष्णम् वै वारि दुःखिताः |
verses.iast:
tasya saṃviśataḥ tatra rudanto vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
nayanebhyaḥ pramumucuḥ uṣṇam vai vāri duḥkhitāḥ |
verses.translation: Apropos to Angada's recumbency on ground, the other outstanding Vanara-s snivellingly sluiced down seethingly effusive teardrops emotionally.

glosses.meaning: his [Angada's,] apropos to, his becoming recumbent
from pairs of eyes, heated [seething,] verily [effusive,] water [teardrops]

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवम् चैव निन्दन्तः प्रशंसन्तः च वालिनम्
परिवार्य अंगदम् सर्वे व्यवस्यन् प्रायम् आसितुम् |
verses.iast:
sugrīvam caiva nindantaḥ praśaṃsantaḥ ca vālinam
parivārya aṃgadam sarve vyavasyan prāyam āsitum |
verses.translation: While disesteeming Sugreeva but esteeming Vali, all of the vanara-s have gathered around Angada deciding to sit down for fasting unto death in step with Angada.

glosses.meaning: for fast unto death, to sit down

verses.devanagari:
तत् वाक्यम् वालि पुत्रस्य विज्ञाय प्लवग ऋषभाः
उपस्पृश्य उदकम् सर्वे प्राक् मुखाः समुपाविशन् |
दक्षिण अग्रेषु दर्भेषु उदक् तीरम् समाश्रिताः
मुमूर्षवओ हरिश्रेष्टा एतत् क्षमम् इति स्म ह |
verses.iast:
tat vākyam vāli putrasya vijñāya plavaga ṛṣabhāḥ
upaspṛśya udakam sarve prāk mukhāḥ samupāviśan |
dakṣiṇa agreṣu darbheṣu udak tīram samāśritāḥ
mumūrṣavao hariśreṣṭā etat kśamam iti sma ha |
verses.translation: Those best ones among fly-jumpers on discerning the words of Angada, the son of Vali, and agreeing to what all said by Angada as appropriate, they positioned themselves on the sacred grass after touching waters sacramentally. The sacred-grass is spread as sacred beds to cast off their lives. The edges of grass blades are positioned southward. As they are on that northern shore of southern ocean, all those best monkeys who are bent on to self-immolation, they became recumbent facing eastward.

glosses.meaning: on southerly, edges [of grass,] on sacred grass
readily, became decumbent. sma ha = they are, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य वन वासम् च क्षयम् दशरथस्य च
जनस्थान वधम् चैव वधम् चैव जटायुषः |
हरणम् चैव वैदेह्या वालिनः च वधम् तथा |
राम कोपम् च वदताम् हरीणाम् भयम् आगतः
verses.iast:
rāmasya vana vāsam ca kśayam daśarathasya ca
janasthāna vadham caiva vadham caiva jaṭāyuṣaḥ |
haraṇam caiva vaidehyā vālinaḥ ca vadham tathā |
rāma kopam ca vadatām harīṇām bhayam āgataḥ
verses.translation: An unknown apprehensive dread came upon those monkeys when they discussed Rama's living in forests, Dasharatha's demise, calamity caused to Janasthaana, casualty to Jataayu, like that the stealing of Vaidehi and slaying of Vali.
notes: Here Maheshvara Tiirtha says that 'an apprehensive dread swept over them subconsciously...' not because of the past episodes, but due to some future events, where their becoming pray to some unknown carnivore, namely Sampaati, is apprehended. Thus, their fasting unto death, as per scriptural sanction is going to fail.

glosses.meaning: while they are talking - about those topics
for monkeys, dread, came upon [the monkeys.]

verses.devanagari:
स संविशद्भिः बहुभिः महीधरो
महाअद्रि कूट प्रमितैः प्लवंगमैः |
बभूव सन्नादित निर्दर अन्तरो
भृशम् नदद्भिः जलदैः इव अंबरम्
verses.iast:
sa saṃviśadbhiḥ bahubhiḥ mahīdharo
mahāadri kūṭa pramitaiḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ |
babhūva sannādita nirdara antaro
bhṛśam nadadbhiḥ jaladaiḥ iva ambaram
verses.translation: While those many fly-jumpers who mirror up great mountaintops by their physique are recumbent discussing stridently, the entrails of caves of mountain are rendered strident, and that mountain itself appeared like skyscape filled with strident clouds about to burst a good fortune.
